name: Rice sheets with pork
summary: Fine woven rice-noodle sheets with roast or grilled pork and offal, scallion fat, herbs, and garlic-chilli fish sauce. In Phú Yên it is the plate of weddings, death anniversaries, and pagoda days.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s food roundup and its 6 October 2024 cẩm nang both describe bánh hỏi lòng heo.
culture: The sheets are bột gạo and slow to make, and they appear at cúng, giỗ, weddings, and rites at the đình and the pagoda. Phú Yên’s tourism office says a visit without them has not happened.
howToEat: Take a sheet with the pork or offal, scallion fat, herbs, and the garlic-chilli sauce. Some cooks add rice paper and a bowl of cháo lòng on the side.
where: Duy Tân and Hùng Vương in town, and An Mỹ on QL1A and Nguyễn Văn Linh.
seoTitle: Banh hoi long heo — rice sheets for a Phu Yen feast
seoDescription: Woven rice sheets with roast pork, offal, scallion fat, and garlic-chilli fish sauce, the Phu Yen feast plate.
